title: extract_post_metadata ignores folded headers: cross-posts stored in wrong groups
description: Trigger: POST with RFC 5322-folded Newsgroups header, e.g. 'Newsgroups: comp.a,\r\n  comp.b'. validate_post_headers uses mailparse (handles folding correctly); extract_post_metadata in lifecycle.rs uses a custom extract_header_value() that splits on lines and grabs only the first line's value. The split-by-comma on 'comp.a,' then discards the empty continuation. Bad behavior: article is stored only in comp.a, comp.b is silently dropped. Security angle: the two parsers disagreeing means validation passes for something that gets stored differently — a class of header injection / content divergence bugs.
